topic: EU proposes €45 billion Ukraine loan package

en.headline: EU proposes 45 billion euro loan for Ukraine in 2027
en.body: The European Commission proposed a new €45 billion loan to Ukraine for 2027, according to the European Commission and The Straits Times. This funding is intended to cover most of Ukraine's €70 billion funding gap, according to CNA.

it.headline: UE propone prestito da 45 miliardi di euro per l'Ucraina nel 2027
it.body: La Commissione europea ha proposto un nuovo prestito di 45 miliardi di euro per l'Ucraina per il 2027, secondo la Commissione europea e The Straits Times. Questo finanziamento dovrebbe coprire la maggior parte del divario di finanziamento di 70 miliardi di euro dell'Ucraina, secondo CNA.

de.headline: EU schlägt 45 Milliarden Euro Kredit für Ukraine im Jahr 2027 vor
de.body: Die Europäische Kommission hat laut Europäischer Kommission und The Straits Times einen neuen Kredit von 45 Milliarden Euro für die Ukraine im Jahr 2027 vorgeschlagen. Dieses Finanzierungsvolumen soll laut CNA die größte Lücke von 70 Milliarden Euro der Ukraine abdecken.

fr.headline: L'UE propose un prêt de 45 milliards d'euros à l'Ukraine en 2027
fr.body: La Commission européenne a proposé un nouveau prêt de 45 milliards d'euros à l'Ukraine pour 2027, selon la Commission européenne et The Straits Times. Ce financement vise à couvrir la majeure partie du déficit de financement de 70 milliards d'euros de l'Ukraine, selon CNA.

es.headline: UE propone un préstamo de 45.000 millones de euros para Ucrania en 2027
es.body: La Comisión Europea propuso un nuevo préstamo de 45.000 millones de euros para Ucrania en 2027, según la Comisión Europea y The Straits Times. Esta financiación está destinada a cubrir la mayor parte del déficit de financiación de Ucrania de 70.000 millones de euros, según CNA.

pt.headline: UE propõe empréstimo de 45 mil milhões de euros para a Ucrânia em 2027
pt.body: A Comissão Europeia propôs um novo empréstimo de 45 mil milhões de euros para a Ucrânia para 2027, segundo a Comissão Europeia e o The Straits Times. Este financiamento destina-se a cobrir a maior parte do défice de 70 mil milhões de euros da Ucrânia, segundo a CNA.

zh.headline: 欧盟提议2027年向乌克兰提供450亿欧元贷款
zh.body: 据欧洲委员会和《海峡时报》报道，欧洲委员会提议向乌克兰提供新的450亿欧元贷款，用于2027年。该资金旨在覆盖乌克兰约70亿欧元的资金缺口，据《联合早报》报道。

ja.headline: EU提案450億歐元貸款給烏克蘭2027年
ja.body: 根據歐洲委員會和《海峽時報》，歐洲委員會提議向烏克蘭提供新的450億歐元貸款，用於2027年。據《聯合報》報導，此項資金旨在覆蓋烏克蘭約700億歐元的資金缺口。

ko.headline: EU 제안, 우크라이나에 2027년 450억 유로 대출
ko.body: 유럽 집행위원회가 유럽 집행위원회와 스트레이츠 타임스에 따르면 우크라이나에 2027년 450억 유로 규모의 새로운 대출을 제안했다. 이 자금은 CNA에 따르면 우크라이나의 700억 유로 자금 부족의 대부분을 충당하기 위해 마련된 것이다.

en.title: EU proposes 45 billion euro loan for Ukraine in 2027
en.dek: European Commission proposes new 45 billion euro loan to Ukraine for 2027 to cover most of Ukraine's funding gap
facts: European Commission proposed a new 45 billion euro loan to Ukraine for 2027
The loan is intended to cover most of Ukraine's 70 billion euro funding gap
The European Commission and The Straits Times confirmed the proposal
CNA reported the loan targets Ukraine's funding gap
The proposal was announced on 18 November 2026
The European Commission is the source of the loan proposal
body: The European Commission proposed a new 45 billion euro loan to Ukraine for 2027, according to the European Commission and The Straits Times.
This funding is intended to cover most of Ukraine's 70 billion euro funding gap, according to CNA.
The European Commission announced the proposal on 18 November 2026, as reported by multiple outlets.
The Straits Times published an explainer detailing the EU's new 45 billion euro Ukraine loan plan on the same date.
CNA reported that the loan would address the majority of Ukraine's estimated funding requirements for the coming period.
The proposal represents a significant financial commitment from the European Union to support Ukraine's budgetary needs.
en.context: The European Commission has proposed financial assistance for Ukraine as part of ongoing support measures, with the loan amount specified as 45 billion euros for the 2027 fiscal year.
